postings.title: Abteilungsleiter:in RAMS-Management
postings.description:
Wir verwirklichen, worauf es ankommt. Mit unseren MitarbeiterInnen

elektrifizieren, automatisieren und digitalisieren wir Österreich.

Siemens Mobility ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG. Siemens Mobility ist seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Transportlösungen und entwickelt sein Portfolio durch Innovationen ständig weiter. Zum Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Mit der Digitalisierung ermöglicht Siemens Mobility Mobilitätsbetreibern auf der ganzen Welt, ihre Infrastruktur intelligent zu machen, eine nachhaltige Wertsteigerung über den gesamten Lebenszyklus sicherzustellen, den Fahrgastkomfort zu verbessern sowie Verfügbarkeit zu garantieren. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter: www.siemens.at/mobility

Wir suchen für unseren Mobility Standort in Wien eine:n Abteilungsleiter:in RAMS-Management.

Als Abteilung RAMS des Application Development Center der SMO RI begleiten wir die Projekte für Systementwicklungen und Anlagenrealisierungen und übernehmen darin die Aufgaben des Safety- und RAM-Managements sowie der Validierung nach relevanten CENELEC-Normen für Bahnanwendungen.

Dabei nehmen wir auch Schnittstellenaufgaben zu internen und externen Gutachtern, Kunden und Zulassungsbehörden für die Belange der Sicherheitsabnahme bzw. Genehmigung wahr.

Wir suchen für die Leitung dieser Abteilung eine erfahrene und durchsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit, die mit Engagement und hoher fachlichen und sozialen Kompetenz die Realisierung nachhaltiger Mobilitätslösungen in einem komplexen, internationalen Umfeld mitgestaltet.

Ihr neues Aufgabenfeld – herausfordernd und zukunftsorientiert

- Als Mitglied unseres Führungsteams sind ihre Hauptaufgaben die Führung der Signalling RAMS Abteilung mit rund 20 Mitarbeiter:innen, für die Themen

- RAMS Management
- Validierungen
- Verifikation
- Information- und Cyber Security
- Sicherheitsnachweisführung
- Qualitätsmanagement und
- Begutachtung und allgemeine Zulassungsthemen

- Sie entwickeln ihr Team und ihre Fähigkeiten weiter.
- Sie organisieren ihre Abteilung, planen die Arbeiten, weisen ihren Mitarbeitern Aufgaben zu und überwachen den Fortschritt
- Sie repräsentieren ihre Abteilung in Führungsbesprechungen, Berichterstattungen und Audits bzw. Reviews
- Sie sind Teil von Expertengruppen und arbeiten bei strategischen Entscheidungen mit.
- Sie repräsentieren Siemens Mobility Rail Infrastructure gegenüber Gutachtern, Zulassungsbehörden, Kunden und innerhalb der Siemens Mobility Gruppe..
- Darüber hinaus begleiten Sie selbstständig die Zulassungsaktivitäten von Projekten bei Aufsichts- und Zulassungsbehörden in aller Welt.

Ihre Qualifikationen – fundiert und adäquat

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in einer Ingenieur- oder informationswissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung (Diplom/Master).
- Langjährige Berufserfahrung und Erfahrungen betreffend Funktionaler Sicherheit und Kenntnisse von Eisenbahnstandards (z.B. EN 50126, 50128, 50129 oder 50716, TS 50701, ISO 27001, ISO 9001) und / oder Zugsicherungstechniken sind von Vorteil
- Sie sind eine offene, kommunikative, belastbare, ziel orientierte Persönlichkeit die aufgeschlossen gegenüber neuem ist.
- Hohe Motivation, sich mit neuen Technologien, Entwicklungsprozessen und Werkzeugen vertraut zu machen
- Sie sind aktuell als RAMS Manager (w/m/d), Validierer (w/m/d), Verifizierer (w/m/d) oder Zulassungsmanager (w/m/d) tätig. Wenn Sie bereits Gutachter (w/m/d) oder Prüfsachverständiger (w/m/d) sind, sind Sie natürlich auch herzlich willkommen.
- Darüber hinaus bringen Sie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit.

Was muss ich noch wissen?

Wir bieten ein attraktives Vergütungspaket, das Ihrer Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung entspricht. Das Bruttojahresgehalt gemäß Kollektivvertrag beträgt für diese Funktion mindestens EUR 88.108,44. Je nach Ausbildung und Erfahrung ist eine Überzahlung möglich. Siemens als Großkonzern bietet darüber hinaus weitere Sozialleistungen und Benefits.

Wie kann ich mich bewerben?

Wenn Sie Interesse an dieser Position haben, dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagekräftige Online Bewerbung. Für weitere Informationen steht Ihnen Herr Rafael Fletzberger unter rafael.fletzberger@siemens.com oder telefonisch unter +43 664 885 57 812 gerne zur Verfügung.

postings.title: BMS Technician
postings.description:
Siemens Smart Infrastructure is shaping the future of buildings by combining digital technologies, automation, and energy management to make environments smarter, safer, and more sustainable. Our Building Technologies business delivers integrated building automation, HVAC, fire, security, and energy solutions across a wide range of customer sites.

We currently have an opportunity for a Service Technician Service Specialist to join our New South Wales Service team. This is a hands-on field-based role working across Sydney and regional NSW, supporting a broad customer base across commercial, health, education, and infrastructure environments.

The NSW Service team plays a critical role in Siemens overall service offering. This position suits someone who enjoys fault finding, working directly with customers, and taking ownership of service outcomes in live operational environments.

Reporting to the NSW Service Team Leader, you will deliver technical service work across preventative maintenance, reactive service, minor upgrades, and small works. You will work across multiple customer sites and be part of an on call and after-hours support roster.

Your responsibilities will include

• Preventative maintenance and reactive service of building automation and HVAC control systems

• Fault finding and rectification of control panels, field devices, networks, and software

• Use of diagnostic tools and remote service platforms to identify and resolve issues

• Evaluation of customer systems and providing technical recommendations

• Supporting site safety activities including OH&S compliance and risk assessments

• Assisting with minor works, upgrades, and commissioning activities

• Providing technical input into quotes, planning, and service delivery where required

• Maintaining accurate service records, reports, and customer documentation

• Building strong working relationships with customers and internal stakeholders

To be successful in this role, you will bring a strong technical foundation, a customer focused mindset, and a practical approach to problem solving.

Essential skills and experience

• Solid understanding of HVAC fundamentals and building services systems

• Experience working in a service or maintenance environment

• Current Victorian Electrical Licence

• Strong fault finding and troubleshooting skills

• Comfortable working independently across multiple sites

• Clear written and verbal communication skills

• Strong customer engagement and interpersonal skills

• Electrical Licence (Open or Restricted)

Desirable skills and experience

• Experience with Building Automation Systems including Siemens Desigo, or similar platforms

• Knowledge of control networks such as BACnet, Modbus, and IP based systems

• PLC or building controls software exposure

• Experience with commissioning, testing, or minor project works

• Understanding of energy efficiency and optimisation principles

• Confidence using mobile devices, service management systems, and Microsoft tools

• Awareness of cyber security and OT network best practice in building systems

We are looking for someone who takes pride in their technical work, cares about customer outcomes, and enjoys being part of a close-knit service team. You will have a practical mindset, a strong safety focus, and a genuine desire to improve system performance and customer satisfaction.

In return, Siemens offers long term career development, exposure to industry leading technologies, and the opportunity to work in a supportive and professional service environment.

If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply.

Siemens is a proud equal opportunity employer, creating a work environment of diversity and inclusion. Our diverse workforce cultivates Innovation and Excellence and in turn creates a workplace where our employees belong and prosper. Diversity and inclusion help us fully realise the potential of our people.

postings.title: Cyber Security Expert "CSE"
postings.description:
Company Overview

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Position Overview

In this role, you will work closely with development, operations, architecture, and product teams to help secure our products, services, and infrastructure. You will identify and mitigate security risks, perform security assessments and penetration testing, support vulnerability management and compliance activities, and drive security improvements across cloud and on-premises environments. You'll combine strong technical cybersecurity expertise with a proactive mindset to help teams build and operate secure, reliable, and compliant solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the cybersecurity focal point for assigned products and development teams, providing guidance on security requirements, risks, and best practices

• Perform security assessments, threat modeling, risk evaluations, and architecture reviews to identify and mitigate security risks early in the development lifecycle

• Conduct and coordinate penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and security validation exercises across applications, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud environments

• Drive remediation activities by working closely with development and operations teams to address security findings and reduce organizational risk

• Support Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) implementation and DevSecOps practices, including security testing and security-by-design principles

• Monitor and manage security vulnerabilities, support compliance activities for cybersecurity standards, and participate in security incident investigations

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science

• 3–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, application security, DevSecOps, or related security discipline

• Strong hands-on experience in penetration testing and vulnerability assessment across web applications, APIs, infrastructure, and cloud environments

• Demonstrated experience identifying, validating, and remediating security vulnerabilities using industry-standard security tools and methodologies

• Solid understanding of secure software development practices, SSDLC, OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, and secure coding principles

• Knowledge of cloud security concepts and platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Kubernetes

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to explain technical security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred:

• Professional certifications such as OSCP, CEH, Security+, AWS Security Specialty, or CKS

• Experience with application security testing technologies (SAST, DAST, dependency analysis, container security scanning)

• Knowledge of security frameworks and standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, IEC 62443, or similar)

• Programming and scripting skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, Go, or Bash for developing security tools and automating security processes

Why Us

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Our Benefits & Rewards

The salary range for this position is "30,000 USD" to "35,000 USD" and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: Benefits | Siemens Digital Industries Software

postings.title: Cyber Security Officer
postings.description:
Vil du være med på å beskytte kritisk infrastruktur i et av verdens ledende teknologiselskaper?

Cybersikkerhet har aldri vært viktigere. Digitalisering, økt tilkobling og et stadig mer komplekst trusselbilde gjør at sikkerhet er en forutsetning for å lykkes, både som virksomhet og som samfunn. Nå søker vi en Cyber Security Officer som vil spille en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle og styrke cybersikkerheten i Siemens AS.

Om rollen:

- I denne rollen blir du selskapets fremste rådgiver innen cybersikkerhet og en viktig sparringspartner for ledelsen, våre forretningsområder og fagmiljøer. Du vil bidra til å omsette globale sikkerhetskrav til praktiske tiltak lokalt, samtidig som du bygger sikkerhetskultur, støtter forretningen og bidrar til å beskytte både virksomheten og våre kundeleveranser.

- Rollen kombinerer strategisk arbeid med operativ oppfølging. Du vil ha ansvar for å identifisere og håndtere risiko, koordinere sikkerhetshendelser, følge opp sårbarheter og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring av sikkerhetsarbeidet. Samtidig vil du være en synlig ressurs i organisasjonen som bistår ledere og medarbeidere med råd, opplæring og kompetansebygging innen cybersikkerhet.

- Du vil samarbeide tett med kollegaer i Norge, Norden og internasjonalt, og være en del av et sterkt fagmiljø som deler erfaringer, kunnskap og velfungerende arbeidsmetoder på tvers av landegrenser.

- Roller innebærer tett samarbeid med IT, juridisk, compliance og salg.

- Du vil være ansvarlig for å omsette nordiske cybersikkerhetsplaner, krav og tiltak til praktisk gjennomføring i Norge. Det innebærer å definere og videreutvikle lokale prosesser slik at de passer forretningsbehovene oq sikre at organisasjonen har riktige verktøy og arbeidsmåter.

- Du vil også ha et sentralt ansvar for å sikre at Siemens Norge etterlever relevante lokale lover, kundekrav og interne krav innen cybersikkerhet, inkludert arbeid knyttet til ISO 27001.

- Stillingen innebærer ansvar som Cyber Security Officer (CSO). Dette innebærer å bidra til at sikkerhet blir en naturlig del av produktene, løsningene og tjenestene vi leverer til våre kunder, samt rådgivning til ledelse, prosjektmiljøer og forretningsområder innen cybersikkerhet.

Hvem ser vi etter?

- Vi ser etter deg som har tidligere erfaring innen cybersikkerhet, gjerne som CISO, CSO eller tilsvarende. Du har jobbet tett med både ledelse og forretning, og har erfaring med å etablere og videreutvikle sikkerhetsstrategier, styringsprosesser og risikohåndtering i komplekse organisasjoner.

- Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring med å omsette cybersikkerhet fra strategi og anbefalinger til praktiske tiltak. Du trives med å skape fremdrift, involvere riktige interessenter og bidra til at cybersikkerhet blir en naturlig del av måten virksomheten jobber på.

- Du trives med å samarbeide tett med mennesker og skape engasjement. Vi ser etter en person som ønsker å være synlig i organisasjonen, bygge relasjoner og bidra til å utvikle både mennesker, prosesser og sikkerhetskultur.

- Erfaring med OT-sikkerhet, kritisk infrastruktur, industriell sikkerhet eller forsvarsrelaterte miljøer vil være en fordel, men er ikke et krav.

- Stillingen krever at du kan kommunisere godt på både norsk og engelsk.

Hvorfor Siemens?

Hos Siemens jobber vi med teknologi som er med på å forme fremtiden. Du blir en del av et internasjonalt selskap med stor tillit til medarbeiderne, sterke fagmiljøer og gode muligheter for personlig og faglig utvikling.

Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktig lønn, en fleksibel arbeidshverdag og fri alle inneklemte dager, romjul og påske. I tillegg har vi gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger og mulighet for å delta i aksjespareprogram for ansatte.

I denne rollen vil du være med på å sikre løsninger og teknologi som brukes av industrien, energisektoren, bygg og kritisk infrastruktur hver eneste dag.

Arbeidssted: Oslo

Hørtes dette interessant ut?

Da håper vi å høre fra deg senest 27.oktober. Stillingen kan bli stengt tidligere dersom vi finner riktig kandidat. Vennligst send inn din CV og søknad på engelsk.

Vi gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk i alle våre rekrutteringsprosesser.

Spørsmål?

Ved spørsmål til stillingen kan du kontakte Inge André Jenssen inge.jenssen@siemens.com

Ved spørsmål knyttet til rekrutteringsprosessen, kontakt Ellen Ahlberg, ellen.ahlberg@siemens.com

postings.title: Executive Business Development Manager
postings.description:
I Siemens Smart Infrastructure Buildings søger vi en Executive Business Development Manager – New Bizz, der skal drive udviklingen af nye strategiske kunder inden for Smart Buildings. Du bliver ansvarlig for at skabe relationer til nogle af Danmarks største virksomheder og positionere Siemens som en strategisk partner inden for intelligente bygninger, digitalisering, sikkerhed, energieffektivitet og bæredygtig drift.

Dette er en rolle for dig, der drives af jagten på nye muligheder, kan navigere på tværs af komplekse organisationer og som har evnen til at samle de rette kompetencer omkring kunden for at skabe konkret forretning og langsigtede partnerskaber.

Du bliver en del af en salgsorganisation, der arbejder tæt sammen og som i hverdagen evner både at have blik for hinanden, mulighederne i markedet og samarbejder tæt omkring hvordan vi sætter det skarpeste hold til enhver opgave. Stillingen kan være baseret i enten Ballerup eller Vejle.

Ansvarsområder

- Identificere, opsøge og udvikle relationer til nye strategiske kunder inden for Smart Buildings.
- Etablere dialog med beslutningstagere og interessenter på C-level og direktionsniveau.
- Forstå kundernes strategiske udfordringer og identificere muligheder inden for blandt andet facility management, energioptimering, cyber security, sikkerhed, digitalisering og optimering af installerede assets.
- Positionere Siemens' samlede portefølje af løsninger og services gennem værdibaseret og rådgivende salg. Det vil ligeledes vægte positivt hvis du har certifikat eller kendskab til principperne omkring Challenger salg.
- Mobilisere og koordinere de rette interne kompetencer på tværs af Comfort, Fire, Security og øvrige specialister for at skabe den stærkeste kundeløsning.
- Drive salgsprocessen fra den første dialog til indgåelse af kommercielle aftaler.

Kvalifikationer

- Du har dokumenteret succes med opsøgende salg, forretningsudvikling eller enterprise-salg af komplekse løsninger.
- Du er troværdig i mødet med stakeholders på C-level og kan skabe adgang til beslutningstagere på højt niveau.
- Du er udpræget menneskekender, læser rummet hurtigt og rigtigt, dine people skills er misundt blandt dem, der kender dig.
- Du har en stærk forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte strategiske udfordringer til kommercielle muligheder.
- Det er en stor fordel, hvis du har erfaring med områder som Smart Buildings, digitalisering, energioptimering, sikkerhed, cyber security eller facility management.
- Du er en stærk teamplayer, som forstår at bringe de rigtige mennesker og kompetencer i spil på det rette tidspunkt.

Du er nysgerrig, vedholdende og relationsskabende. Du ser muligheder, hvor andre ser barrierer, og du trives med at åbne nye døre og skabe adgang til beslutningstagere. Hos Siemens tror vi på, at de bedste løsninger bliver skabt af mennesker med forskellige perspektiver og baggrunde. Derfor tilbyder vi et internationalt og innovativt arbejdsmiljø med store muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Siemens Smart Infrastructure forbinder energisystemer, bygninger og industrier for at skabe mere effektive, intelligente og bæredygtige samfund.

Vores løsninger bidrager til lavere energiforbrug, øget komfort og mere bæredygtig og kontinuerlig drift.

Interesseret?

Så send os din ansøgning! Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og opfordrer dig derfor til at sende din hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Siemens Software, a business unit of the Siemens Digital Industries, is a leading global provider of software solutions to drive the digital transformation of industry, creating new opportunities for manufacturers to realize innovation.

About this Role:

We are looking for an Information Security Management Specialist to make ISO 27001 compliance part of our simulation software teams’ daily habits—not just a tick-box exercise.

In this role, you will translate Annex A controls into practical engineering practices, help teams produce documentation that genuinely reflects how they work, and ensure the evidence behind every control is complete, current, and easy for an auditor to verify.

What You’ll Be Doing

ISO 27001 Control Guidance

- Interpret ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls for software teams onboarding to the certificate, with a particular focus on technological controls (A.8)—including secure development life cycle, secure coding, security testing, change management, incident management, and separation of environments (development, test, and production).
- Map controls to existing engineering workflows so compliance is embedded directly into everyday processes and tooling.

Documentation

- Partner with teams to write and maintain clear, concise procedures and work instructions that support secure development and satisfy both Siemens Digital Industries Software policies and the ISO standard.
- Produce templates and reference examples that make good documentation the easiest path to take.
- Facilitate regular reviews so documents remain current, version-controlled, and consistent with real-world practice.

Evidence and Audit Readiness

- Define what good, objective evidence looks like for each relevant control and establish where it lives.
- Help teams automate evidence collection from source control, CI/CD pipelines, security scanners, and cloud platforms wherever possible.
- Run internal evidence reviews, tracking gaps and nonconformities through to resolution.
- Support external certification and surveillance audits, including preparing evidence packs and accompanying engineering teams during auditor sessions.

Risk and Continuous Improvement

- Contribute to information security risk assessments for products and services, helping teams own and implement treatment plans.

- Significative experience in information security, governance, risk, and compliance (GRC), or security assurance.

- Solid working knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001, specifically the 2022 Annex A control set.
- Hands-on experience preparing for or supporting ISO 27001 certification or surveillance audits.
- Strong critical eye for audit evidence—able to evaluate whether artifacts are sufficient, objective, and traceable, and explain gaps without unnecessary jargon.
- Excellent technical writing ability: capable of producing structured, concise documentation engineers will actually read and use.

- Familiarity with adjacent frameworks and standards (e.g., SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, NIST CSF, OWASP SAMM/ASVS).
- Experience with compliance automation platforms and evidence gathering from tools such as GitHub/GitLab, Jira, SAST/DAST scanners, and AWS/Azure.
- Understanding of secure design practices, such as threat modelling and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) management.
- An interest in emerging areas like AI governance and ISO/IEC 42001.

Personal Attributes

- Collaborative: Earns trust with engineers by understanding practical delivery constraints and offering pragmatic solutions, not just audit findings.
- Structured: Organises complex documentation sets into clean, logical hierarchies.
- Detail-oriented: Detects weak, missing, or ambiguous evidence well before an auditor does.

postings.description:
Hey Innovator!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.

Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an extraordinary addition to our vibrant team.

Siemens Technology and Services Private Limited (STSPL) is the Indian subsidiary of German multinational engineering and electronics conglomerate Siemens that focuses on IT and management services. The subsidiary is split into four units: Corporate Technology India, Siemens Corporate Finance and Controlling, Global Shared Services, and Siemens Management Consulting. Located in Balewadi High Street in Pune, it has over 5000 employees.

We are looking for a Protection & Automation Engineer meeting the need for smart-mobility solutions.

We are making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions.

Your new role – Challenging and future oriented

This role focuses on delivering Protection, Automation & Control engineering for Railway & Metro traction substations, OHE/PS systems, and depot power systems. The engineer must have strong command over Siemens SIPROTEC relays, Siemens PLCs, A8000 RTUs, and communication protocols commonly used in rail applications.

1. Protection Engineering for Railway Systems

- Prepare protection philosophy & settings for 25 kV AC traction substations.
- Configure and test SIPROTEC 4/5 series relays for Distance protection, Transformer protection, Distance protection, Busbar protection

- Implement CFC logic for advanced interlocking used in railway traction power.
- Implement cyber security hardening measures

2. Railway Control & Automation

- Program Siemens PLC (S7 1500/ ET200SP) for local/remote control in Traction Substation, Sectioning Post, paralleling Posts, SP, SSP.
- Implement interlocking logic for breakers, isolators, ATs & protection coordination.
- Integrate PLC/RTU with SCADA systems used in railways.

3. Siemens RTU (A8000) Engineering

- Engineer and configure A8000 RTUs for railway substations.
- Develop IEC 60870 5 104/101 communication with Operation Control Center (OCC)
- Create & integrate IEC 61850 SCD/ICD files for traction power automation.

4. Documentation & Project Delivery

- Prepare railway specific engineering documents:
- Traction Substation, Sectioning Post, Paralleling Posts, Sub-Sectioning and Paralleling Post protection concept Drawings
- Control & interlocking philosophy
- Network Diagrams

- Support Factory Integration Tests (FIT)/Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and support for commissioning.
- Ensure compliance with IEC, EN, IEEE & local standards.
- Support Project manager / Technical manager with Project planning

We don’t need superheroes, just super minds

- Siemens DIGSI 4 & 5
- TIA Portal for Siemens PLC
- Siemens A8000 engineering tools
- IEC 61850, IEC 104, Modbus, DNP3, Profinet
- Visio for drawings
- Bonus points for fundamental project management knowledge
- Willingness to travel (e.g., for site visits, FAT/FIT support, commissioning)
- Proactive and detail-oriented mindset
- Fluent in English (written and spoken). Additional language skills [e.g., German] are a plus.

Qualifications

- B.E/B. Tech in Electrical or Power System Engineering
- 8-12 years of working experience with railway traction projects, metro projects, or utility substations
- Familiarity with ISO / IEC standards (added advantage)
- Experience with Railway Traction power supply concepts (added advantage)

This role is based in Pune. You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

As part of the global Cybersecurity Assurance function, we help Siemens to achieve their goals by providing objective, factual and independent assurance to the Siemens Managing Board and Audit Committee. To deliver on our vision of being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, we offer a unique Grow and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong learning and therefore encourage our people towards a mindset where continuous upskilling and reskilling becomes a natural part of our career. Our Cybersecurity team provides core assurance over the cybersecurity health of the company which includes IT infrastructures, product security, software development and cloud environments. We are on the lookout for people with a great skillset, an international mindset and new ideas who understand Siemens businesses and how Cybersecurity helps enable and increase market value. Are you one of them?

To discover more about the global Siemens assurance function click here.

- As valuable member of the assurance team you will be responsible for conducting Cybersecurity assessments across the entire Siemens landscape, including products, services, IT-systems, and software development centers. During this process you will perform ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations to translate technical findings into management information so that they can take effective actions.
- Apply hacking principles and red team methodologies, tools and techniques to mimic real-world threat behaviors faced by the Siemens’s digital environment, e.g. cloud applications, on-premise infrastructure, digital products and services.
- You work closely with cybersecurity experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern challenges.
- You independently conduct research on latest developments in cybersecurity technologies and threats and understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.

- Strong academic history (Bachelor degree) in IT, Computer Science or other related fields; certifications such as GIAC GPEN, OSCP, CRTP, eJPT, CREST, etc. are a plus.
- Good scripting and programming skills and experience with languages such as Bash, Python, Powershell, and C++ / C#.
- At least 2+ years of professional full-time working experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing / red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.
- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the latest trends in cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously challenging environment.
- You have first experience with one or more of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.
- Demonstrated first experience in capture the flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a plus.
- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.
- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.
- You demonstrate an international mindset and are open to international travel, and working in a diverse team.

While commitment to our job improves performance, growth happens when we stretch beyond our comfort zone. FIN A offers ample opportunities to seek the challenge:

Caring for the world around us is a crucial part of our working culture at FIN A for over a decade.

Everyone at FIN A has the possibility to actively engage in our global Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) community and make an impact with our socially and environmentally motivated CSR projects.

What we offer

- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a future global standard
- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging
- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family (for Germany)
- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG
- Pension plan to ensure financial security
- 50+ learning hours per year for both personal and professional growth

Why us?

Working at Siemens Digital Industries Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We look forward to your application! Please use only our career platform, which you can access via "Apply now". Send us an email to careers-DACH.sisw@siemens.com, if you would like to clarify initial questions with our recruiting team. Contact person for this job advertisement is Nadia Dzianisawa. Come and learn more about Siemens Software: Mission / Vision and our software portfolio - or visit our homepage.

The salary range for this position is 61,400 EUR to 98,400 EUR and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate’s job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. postings.title: Senior Network Design Engineer - HS2
postings.description:
At Siemens Mobility, we are transforming rail infrastructure through innovative signalling, communications, control and electrification systems. Within our Communications & Information Systems (CIS) business, we deliver mission-critical Network, Telecoms and Security solutions supporting operational railway systems across the UK and beyond.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Design Engineer to support the assured development and delivery of network, operational telecommunications and security system designs for HS2, while also providing technical support to the wider networks team. The role combines technical leadership, requirements management, system integration, stakeholder coordination and design assurance across complex, multidisciplinary rail environments.

HS2 and Wider Networks Context

HS2 is one of Europe’s largest infrastructure programmes and will deliver a high-speed railway connecting London and the West Midlands. Siemens Mobility has been awarded contracts covering key rail systems, including Operational Telecommunications and Security Systems for the HS2 route. The role requires robust technical coordination, clear system definition, evidence-based assurance and close alignment with HS2 requirements, interfaces and review processes, while also supporting wider network design activities across the CIS business.

The role supports the development of secure, resilient and maintainable telecommunications and security designs that interface with wider HS2 rail systems, civil infrastructure, station systems, control systems and operational railway processes.

The Role

The Senior Network Design Engineer is responsible for leading and supporting network, telecoms and security design activities across HS2 and wider network programmes. This includes defining, assuring and developing secure, resilient architectures supporting operational telecommunications, security systems, voice services, data networks, station and route-wide communications, and interfaces with Signalling, SCADA, M&E, station systems and wider railway control systems.

Working closely with HS2, project engineering, delivery partners, system integration teams, multidisciplinary design teams and the wider networks team, the role ensures that solutions are developed safely, securely and efficiently, with clear requirements traceability, interface control, design governance and acceptance evidence throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

- Undertake the role of Senior Engineer, providing technical leadership across HS2 network, operational telecommunications and security system design activities, with additional support to wider network design work where required.

- Lead the development of high-level and low-level architectures for secure, resilient and maintainable telecoms and security systems.

- Act as Responsible Engineer or independent checker where assigned, ensuring outputs are technically robust and suitable for client review.

- Support requirements management, including allocation, interpretation, compliance evidence and traceability within HS2 requirements processes.

- Coordinate design interfaces with Signalling, SCADA, M&E, station systems, security systems, civil infrastructure and other rail systems packages.

- Support IDC, IDR and other assurance review cycles by preparing design evidence, responding to comments and managing technical close-out.

- Produce architecture diagrams, system descriptions, interface information, design reports, technical specifications and assurance documentation.

- Define IP addressing, subnetting, network segmentation, resilience and cyber security strategies appropriate to an operational railway environment.

- Support system integration, testing, commissioning, migration and maintainability considerations for HS2 and wider network systems.

- Apply CDM 2015 and Safe by Design principles by identifying design hazards, managing residual risks and communicating safety-related assumptions and constraints.

Systems Scope

- Operational data networks, LAN/WAN infrastructure and associated routing, switching and resilience arrangements.

- Telecommunications services including voice, bearer network interfaces, operational communications and route-wide connectivity.

- Server/ Hypervisor build and deployment.

- Integration with HS2 and wider rail systems, including station systems, control systems, SCADA, signalling and operational railway management arrangements.

Essential Requirements

- Degree-qualified in Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

- Established knowledge of the systems engineering lifecycle within a railway or mission-critical infrastructure environment.

- Demonstrable experience in leading the delivery of an IP/MPLS transmission network in an Operational Telecommunications environment.

- Experience delivering network, telecoms or security solutions within safety-related, operational or highly regulated environments.

- Knowledge of requirements management, compliance evidence, design assurance and technical governance processes.

- Ability to manage technical interfaces, assumptions, dependencies and design constraints across multidisciplinary project teams.

- Strong communication, stakeholder engagement and leadership skills, with the ability to present complex technical solutions clearly.

- Ability to work effectively to challenging project timescales and formal review milestones.

- Significant experience with LAN/WAN network architectures, operational networks, cyber-secure infrastructure and railway telecoms design.

- Strong understanding of network security principles, segmentation, resilience, access control and operational technology security considerations.

- Experience producing Network designs for Signalling, SCADA, Voice, SISS, CCTV, access control, security systems or backbone communications networks.

- Cisco CCNA level knowledge or above, supported by significant practical experience.

- Experience producing design documentation suitable for IDC, IDR or equivalent client assurance review processes.

- Ability to support comment resolution, design change control, configuration management and acceptance evidence development.

Design Assurance and Expected Outputs

- System definition inputs, system boundary descriptions and supporting design assumptions.

- Architecture drawings, design reports, technical specifications and interface control information.

- Requirements compliance evidence, traceability records and supporting acceptance rationale.

- IDC, IDR and review packs, including response to comments and evidence of technical close-out.

- Design risk information, CDM residual risk outputs and Safe by Design evidence.

Desirable Requirements

- Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards professional registration.

- IRSE Licence or demonstrable experience working within railway engineering assurance processes.

- Experience in UK railway operational telecommunications, preferably on HS2, Network Rail or other major rail infrastructure programmes.

- Knowledge of signalling, SCADA, radio, M&E, station systems, control rooms and operational railway interfaces.

- Experience with software defined networking, network virtualisation, data centre technologies or network automation in secure infrastructure environments.

- Knowledge of cyber security technologies including next generation firewalls, SIEM, IAM, threat intelligence platforms and operational technology security monitoring.

- Experience supporting design package planning, deliverable scheduling and readiness for formal client submissions.

During this process you will plan, perform and lead ethical hacking activities, design attack scenarios for state-of-the-art technologies and highlight important observations to translate technical findings into management information so that they can take effective actions.

- You work closely with Cybersecurity experts from multiple industries to improve their solutions by tackling the root cause of the issues and find innovative solutions to modern challenges.
- You independently conduct research on latest developments in Cybersecurity technologies and threats and understand how this is impacting and changing the Siemens’ environment.
- Furthermore, you will drive the continuous improvement of our internal audit processes, tools as well as documentation and coach junior team members.

- Good scripting and programming skills and experience with languages such as Bash, Python, Powershell, and C++ / C#.
- At least 7+ years of professional full-time working experience within Siemens or a related industry in penetration testing / red teaming with a proven record of continuous career development.
- Demonstrated affinity to learn about the latest trends in Cybersecurity and keep up to date in a continuously challenging environment.
- You have extensive experience with one or more of the following aspects of penetration testing / red teaming: application and software security, EDR and antivirus evasion, C2 setup, automation and scaling of security testing, Active Directory attacks, etc.
- Demonstrated experience in capture the flag (CTFs) events, bug hunting or vulnerability research (CVEs) is a plus.
- Experience with leveraging and integrating AI into day-to-day work is considered an advantage.
- Fluent in English. German or other languages are a plus.

- An environment where everyone can bring their whole self to work and feel a sense of belonging
- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family (for Germany)

Why us?

Unsere R&D-Organisation entwickelt ein breites Produktportfolio – von elektromechanischen Produkten bis hin zu cloudbasierten SaaS-Lösungen. Als Center of Competence (CoC) steuern und unterstützen wir mehrere R&D-Portfolio-Einheiten mit übergreifenden Funktionen, wie Prozessmanagement, ALM- & PLM-Werkzeugen, Nutzerdokumentation und der Adoption von künstlicher Intelligenz.

Wir bauen eine neue Führungsrolle auf, um die Software-Entwicklungsumgebung unserer R&D-Organisation auf das nächste Level zu heben. Als Team Lead (w/m/d) SW Developer Experience & ALM Tools führst du das Team, das die Effizienz unserer Entwicklungsumgebung standardisiert und skaliert – für Embedded-, Desktop- als auch Cloud-Anwendungen. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen und KI-Agenten künftig gemeinsam entwickeln, und sorgst dafür, dass dabei Architektur-, Coding-, Qualitäts- und Cybersecurity-Standards eingehalten werden.

Was wir dir bieten:

- Ansprechendes Vergütungspaket
- Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowohl für deine berufliche als auch persönliche Entwicklung
- 30 Tage Urlaub sowie vielfältige, flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, die eine Auszeit für dich und deine Familie ermöglichen
- Zugang zu Aktienplänen für Mitarbeitende
- Barrierefreie Standorte

Da jeder von uns 300.000 Mitarbeitenden andere Benefits als besonders wichtig empfindet und wir an dieser Stelle nicht unser ganzes Benefit-Portfolio auflisten können, findest du hier weitere Informationen.

Die einzelnen Benefits unterliegen gesetzlichen, tarif-/vertraglichen oder betrieblichen Bedingungen.

Verändere die Welt von morgen:
- Du führst das Team, das die Software-Entwicklungsumgebung für Embedded, Desktop und Cloud Anwendungen standardisiert und skaliert – von Tooling über Self-Service-Workflows bis zu virtuellen Entwicklungsumgebungen. Dabei etablierst du agentische KI und Automatisierung als festen Bestandteil des Entwickleralltags.
- Mit deinem Team definierst du Guidelines und Guardrails für Entwickler und Agenten, die Architektur-, Coding- und Qualitätsstandards sichern. Du integrierst sie so in Workflows und Tooling, dass sie die Teams unterstützen, statt sie zu bremsen.
- Du verantwortest den Betrieb der Plattform inklusive Virtueller Maschinen für Build- und Test-Agenten und behandelst deren Verfügbarkeit als geschäftskritisch. Professionelles Monitoring, Eskalationswege und Betriebsprozesse sorgen dafür, dass Ausfälle vermieden und schnell behoben werden.
- Du stellst sicher, dass deine Systeme die Informationssicherheits- und Cyber-Security-Anforderungen der globalen R&D-Organisation erfüllen. Ein Security-Experte in deinem Team unterstützt dich dabei und begleitet interne wie externe Audits.
- Du machst den Erfolg über Developer-Experience- und Produktivitäts-Metriken messbar und gewinnst damit die Produkt-Teams für die gemeinsame Plattform.

So überzeugst du uns:

- Ausbildung: Du hast einen Masterabschluss in Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Fach sowie langjährige Führungserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung.
- Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse:

- Du bringst umfassende Führungserfahrung in Softwareentwicklung und IT-Systemen mit.
- Du verfügst über tiefgehende Kenntnisse in Informationssicherheit und Cyber-Security im Umfeld von R&D Organisationen.
- Du hast intensive Erfahrung mit agentischer KI im Software-Entwicklungszyklus und kennst dich sowohl mit Embedded- als auch Cloud-Anwendungen aus.

- Arbeitsweise: Du überzeugst durch unternehmerisches Denken, Entscheidungsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, agile Arbeitsweisen verständlich zu vermitteln.
- Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Du bist viel mehr als deine Qualifikationen und wir glauben an das Potenzial jeder einzelnen Person. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Bei Siemens sind wir überzeugt: Wer sich wertgeschätzt und zugehörig fühlt, kann das eigene Potenzial voll entwickeln. Deshalb schaffen wir ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Person ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit erfährt und in dem individuelle Perspektiven und Erfahrungen geschätzt werden. Unser Engagement für Fairness und Respekt gilt für alle Bewerbenden.

Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, ausdrücklich auch von Menschen mit Behinderung. Bei gleicher Qualifikation werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Über uns

Bist du bereit, die Energiewende voranzutreiben?

Unsere Mission ist es, innovative und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln, die sowohl Energieeinsparungen ermöglichen als auch den CO₂-Fußabdruck von Gebäuden und Infrastrukturen reduzieren. Deshalb setzen wir bei Siemens im Bereich Smart Infrastructure Electrification & Automation alles daran, eine grünere Zukunft zu gestalten und unsere Lebens- und Arbeitsweise zu revolutionieren.

Mehr Informationen zum Bereich und den Produkten findest du hier: https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/themenfelder/smart-infrastructure.html

postings.description:
Job Description: Technical Property Manager (Civil)

Base Location

Siemens, Kalwa Works

Main Responsibility

Ensure properly execution of maintenance projects and know the set of technical assets/equipment.

Responsible for achievement of project targets in agreed quality, maintenance volume/budget & timelines.

Provide Civil Engineering expertise to maintenance projects in India for Civil & Interiors (RCC or PEB structures for factory, utility building, Road & infrastructure, office & interior fitouts).

Department

Siemens Real Estate (SRE)

Key Skill

Able to lead self & others with open, collaborative & appreciative mindset.

1. Professional Skills: -

Expert –

Project Management,

Maintenance Principles,

Technical Planning & concept development,

Technical product /system knowledge,

Environment health & safety (EHS) guidelines.

Advance –

Knowledge on Sustainability,

Stakeholder MGMT,

IFM Provider MGMT

Basic –

Customer management &

Space MGMT

2. Digital Skills: -

Advance –

Data Interpretation &

Data Management

Basic –

Artificial Intelligence,

Cloud Technologies,

Cyber Security

3. Interpersonal Skills: -

Advance –

Analytical Problem Solving/ Decision making,

Collaborating in business Ecosystem,

Teamwork & Collaboration,

Conflict MGMT

Basic –

Strategic Thinking & ability to convince

Key Responsibilities

· Handle Local Real estate lifecycle maintenance projects & customer specific maintenance projects.

· Develop long term maintenance plans & applications for maintenance investments.

· Plan & manage technical projects to ensure successful implementation.

· Develop & implement technical concept/projects to reduce costs eg. Maintenance & opex.

· Advise operational project management & customers in building technology aspects.

· Ensure adherence to maintenance principles, guidelines & processes.

· Responsible for the execution of local EHS aspects and to minimize the risk to ensure legally compliant operations and live Zero Harm Culture

· Steer/ Ensure adherence to local building standards and regulations including proper documentation of owned buildings in asset register.

· Maintain your knowledge & understanding about technical assets/equipment and its conditions.

· Understand technical interferences & impacts of technical assets/equipment, taking sustainability & EHS in maintenance into account.

· Understand Cost structure of technical asset Equipment and cost drivers in detail and monitor given budget for the project.

· Act as local interface to Facility Management providers for hard services.

· Steer & track delivery of hard facility services and review existing services regarding provider quality & customer demand.

· Support evaluation & selection of outsourced vendor & service providers for hard facility services in alignment with Regional Asset Manager.

· Coordination with SRE central team, EHS, SCM, Sustainability team, Security team, Commercial

· Provide Civil Engineering expert support to all projects during project planning, Design Engineering & Execution of Civil, Infrastructure and Interior fit out projects . (RCC & PEB structures for factory,

Utility buildings, Office interiors, Road & infrastructure etc)

Required Competencies

· Graduate in Civil Engineering with factory & office experience of around 10 years. For PG candidate (premium institute) 5-7 years’ experience at Key positions.

· People management skills. Business & Customer focus. Stakeholder management.

· Digital acumen, proficiency in digital tools and systems. Prepare Power point presentations of project reports for management review.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong interpersonal skills.

· Result oriented, Sense of urgency, Drive a culture of owner ship, accountability, and continuous improvement.

· Commercial Skills required for meeting SRE goals
